evidence.ACL: Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
evidence.MCL: Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Intact, with thickening of the proximal ligament suggestive of prior injury.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Medial meniscus: High-grade radial tear of the posterior root with moderate peripheral extrusion and superimposed complex tearing of the body and posterior horn.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
evidence.Medial OA: Medial compartment cartilage: Large areas of full-thickness chondrosis along the weightbearing femoral condyle
evidence.Lateral OA: Lateral compartment cartilage: Low-grade partial-thickness cartilage loss along the femoral condyle and tibial plateau.
evidence.PF OA: Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Full-thickness cartilage loss along the superior aspect of the medial patellar facet
evidence.Contusion: Focal subchondral marrow edema at the anterior peripheral margin of the medial tibial plateau.
